sources.ensemble: 20260614_175934_ensemble_meta.json — NNLS blend score=25.582 (worse than best single gbdt=25.549); choice=best_single:gbdt
sources.stability: 20260614_175934_model_stability_by_split.json — single-fold cv_mae_std=0.0 (only 1 split reported for both specialists)
sources.residuals: 20260614_175934_state.json residual_analysis — Q4 mean_residual=+19.41 (true quantile), high_value_bias=systematic_underprediction (65.1% of top-value rows underpredicted, mean_residual=+19.18), heteroscedasticity_corr=0.454

key_findings: GBDT specialist improved floor by 1.0% (25.549 vs 25.811); improvement vs dummy baseline is 82.1%.
Linear family (elastic_net cv=90.48) performed 3.5x worse than floor — received NNLS weight 0.014 (near-zero) in the blend but was still included.
NNLS blend (25.582) lost to best single GBDT (25.549); blend degraded result slightly — linear family is dead weight.
Only 1 CV split reported for specialists (cv_mae_std=0.0); this is a single-fold eval, not full 5-fold CV scored at specialist level, limiting generalization confidence.

Residual analysis shows systematic underprediction of high-value rows: 65.1% of top-quantile true values underpredicted, mean residual=+19.18. Q4 (by true quantile) mean_residual=+19.41 vs Q1 mean_residual=-2.98. Heteroscedasticity corr=0.454 (moderate).

Sub-target modeling (predict casual + registered separately and sum) was recommended by data-pattern-analyzer (registered r=0.970, casual r=0.690 with count) but does NOT appear to have been implemented — the feature set in state.json shows no tgt_* or casual/registered derived features.

Within-period early-day aggregates (group mean by hour/month/year/workingday) were recommended as the primary leakage-safe temporal signal but are absent from authored_features_used in specialist outputs.
GBDT specialist search_effort.tune_iter and seeds are both null — no evidence of hyperparameter tuning or seed-averaging was performed.

suggestions.suggestion: Implement sub-target modeling: predict 'registered' and 'casual' separately (both train-only, high r with count: 0.97 and 0.69), sum predictions to form 'count'. This is the primary untapped accuracy lever as shown in state.json sub_target_correlations.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In feature_pipeline.py, add target columns 'registered' and 'casual' to the training feature spec as sub-targets; train two GBDT models per fold, sum OOF predictions as the count OOF. They are absent from prediction data so no leakage risk.

suggestions.suggestion: Add within-period early-day group aggregates: for each (hour, month, year, workingday, season) group, compute mean/median/std of count using only rows with day <= 13 (safe early-period). These are leakage-free and the data-pattern-analyzer identified them as the top temporal signal substitute for lags.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In feature_pipeline.py, compute per-fold groupby(['datetime__hour','datetime__month','datetime__year','workingday']).agg({'count':['mean','std']}) restricted to day<=13 training rows; merge back to full train+pred set.

suggestions.suggestion: Drop 'datetime__day' as a model feature: data-pattern-analyzer confirmed it shifts from train mean=10 to test mean=25 (z=2.78, severity=medium). Its inclusion degrades generalization to the 20-31 day range. Currently included in final_feature_columns per state.json.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Remove 'datetime__day' from feature_spec.json groups and feature_pipeline.py output columns. It was flagged in validation_implications as 'do not use datetime__day as a direct feature'.

suggestions.suggestion: Blacklist linear family from NNLS blend: elastic_net cv=90.48 vs floor=25.81 (250% worse); NNLS weight=0.014 (near-zero); blend score 25.582 is worse than best single 25.549. Drop linear from next round's pool to remove noise.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Set linear specialist NNLS weight to 0 / exclude from ensemble_meta candidates. Already surfaced in ensemble_meta.json choice=best_single:gbdt.

suggestions.suggestion: Enable seed-averaging for the GBDT specialist: search_effort.seeds=null in agent_gbdt.json indicates no seed ensemble was performed. Add seeds=[42,123,456] and average OOF predictions to reduce variance by ~10-15% on high-variance splits.
suggestions.implementation_hint: Pass AWARDB_SEEDS=3 or similar env var to gbdt-specialist; average the 3 seed OOFs before scoring.

suggestions.suggestion: Apply log1p transform to the count target before GBDT training to address the systematic high-value underprediction (heteroscedasticity_corr=0.454, Q4 mean_residual=+19.41). Exponentiate predictions back before scoring.
suggestions.implementation_hint: In gbdt specialist, wrap target with np.log1p before fit and np.expm1 after predict. lightgbm_sqrt already uses sqrt transform — extend this to the primary lightgbm variant.

notes: Strong improvement vs baseline (82%). GBDT wins cleanly; linear is dead weight. Two high-impact levers are untapped: sub-target modeling (registered r=0.97) and within-period early-day group aggregates. datetime__day inclusion is a known distribution-shift risk per the data pattern report. Residuals show persistent high-value underprediction (mean residual +19 in Q4). Single-fold specialist CV limits stability confidence.
